Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Tau Idair]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']].<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

==Prelude==
At the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], following the [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|Mission to the Emperor's Fortress]], the [[Alliance Commander]], whilst going to meet with [[Lana Beniko]], received a sudden call from [[Tau Idair]], who warned the Commander that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Barus Rava]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sal-Deron]] had arrived on Odessen. This was in an attempt to catch the Commander off-guard, preventing them from explaining the current situation. After briefly pausing to let a pair of Republic troopers pass her, Idair explained that the Republic was still suffering from lost ground against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], continued [[Hidden Chain]] attacks, supply chain disruptions, riots, and the rise of organized crime. In addition, their superiors were determined to pin [[Malgus's escape]] on the Commander, which she suspected was due to Rava's rising influence over Rans. The Commander requested that Idair stall the others so they could proceed to meet with Beniko, [[Theron Shan]], and [[T7-O1]]. After the Commander told them of the Republic leadership's arrival, Beniko then stated their order of business. [[Darth Jadus]] had sent an encrypted transmission to Odessen. Teeseven managed to decrypt it and found a set of coordinates. Unsure of where the coordinates led, Beniko suggested asking the Supreme Chancellor for support in neutralizing Jadus before he could become a threat. However, Shan felt it would only complicate their current situation.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Chancellor_Rans_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|250px|left|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans|Rans]] arrives on [[Odessen]].]]
The Commander and their advisors then went out to meet the Republic emissaries and were surprised to see them back up by a large contingent of troopers. Between the Commander and Rans' delegation, arguments sprouted up over [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] going rogue, only worsening the Hidden Chain attacks. The discussion was then moved to Alliance Operations, where Rans demanded the Alliance relinquish [[Darth Nul]]'s [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]]. Sal-Deron, in an attempt to open the holocron, was violently thrown against a wall. Both Sal-Deron and Rava then accused the Commander of tampering with the relic to hide its secrets, as they were the only one who had access to it. Rans put an end to the argument and declared that until Malgus was caught or they had confirmed that the Commander hadn't tampered with the holocron in any way, the Commander was confined to Odessen.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Sal-Deron_and_holocron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Master [[Sal-Deron]] seizes [[Darth Nul's holocron]].]]
After Rans, Rav, and Sal-Deron had left the room with the holocron, Idair and [[Arn Peralun]] expressed their outrage at the unfair order. Idair admitted she suspected this would be the outcome, and blamed it on Rava's need to control everything and everyone around him. The group then concluded that the Commander and Idair had to escape, steal back the holocron, and investigate Jadus' coordinates. Suspecting that they were walking into a trap, Peralun insisting on coming. However, Idair argued that it's better that he stay to allay suspicion. While Idair was busying scoping out security, Beniko and Shan helped the Commander navigate the maintenance tunnels into the base's cantina and into the cold storage room. The Commander was then told to wait while Teeseven controlled a loader droid to procure standard Republic trooper armor so they could sneak out undetected. When the Commander exited the base, Idair pointed out that their ship was being guarded, forcing them to steal one of the shuttles. Once they were in space, Idair passed the Commander the holocron. As they approached the Republic fleet, Idair assured her ally that their shuttle had both the proper flight clearance and security codes to enable them to pass by without alerting suspicion. After bypassing the Republic fleet, the pair then jumped into hyperspace.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

==The mission==
[[File:Enigma_planet.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The [[Alliance Commander]] arrives at [[Darth Jadus]]'s coordinates.]]
Their shuttle arrived at Jadus' coordinates over a green gas giant<ref name="The Master's Enigma" /> in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|The Enigma}}</ref> Descending into the atmosphere, they found a large vessel of unknown make and landed in one of the docking bays. As they started to explore the vessel, they were suddenly attacked by [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] that emerged from one of the vents, but they quickly killed them. They then took the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to another level, where they were greeted by a host of Jadus' acolytes, who then escorted the pair to the throne room where Jadus himself was waiting. He welcomed them to the ''[[Enigma (research vessel)|Enigma]]'' and admitted he was uncertain if the Commander was going to accept his invitation. He then claimed that they had mutual goals that involved defeating Heta Kol and Malgus and bring order to the galaxy.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Enigma.jpg|thumb|220px|right|The [[Enigma (research vessel)|''Enigma'']].]]
He then explained that the [[Holocron Machine|version]] of Darth Nul's machine the Commander [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|destroyed]] on the [[Hidden Chain flagship|Hidden Chain's prison ship]] was merely a prototype and that Heta Kol was nearing the completion of a larger-scale version of Nul's creation that Malgus intended to seize from her. He went on to explain Malgus' motivations; after being repeated defeating, enslaved and imprisoned, the once mighty Sith warrior had become broken, driven mad by his need for legacy and vengeance. In awakening the Force in others on a galactic scale, he hoped to burn his name in the stars while everything becomes consumed in chaos and fear, but Jadus intended to act as the order to the chaos and establish his own dominion. However, the one piece missing was Nul's holocron, which was bound to the Commander. Jadus stated that the holocron held both connection and control of all Nul's creations, including the ''Enigma''. However, its full power was not yet unlocked, for Nul's machine could not be mastered without doing so.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Jadus in throne room.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Darth Jadus welcomes the Alliance Commander.]]
Jadus then sent both the Commander and Idair into the lower levels of the ship to find a way to unlock the holocron. Down below, they found two biomes, one designed with Jedi architecture and the other a swamp resembling [[Dromund Kaas]], separately managed by two "[[Artificial intelligence/Legends|research protocols]]", Nul and Raniah, which were both based on Nul's experiences as Sith and Jedi. The two protocols both reacted to the holocron, but refused to perform "assimilation" until their experiments were completed. Recognizing that they had unintentionally created ecological stagnation in their attempts to prove their creator's theories, the Commander and Idair reverting the biomes to their natural state, causing the protocols to realize the error of their ways before transferring their intelligences to the ship's mainframe.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Enigma_biome.jpg|thumb|280px|right|One of the biomes inside the ''Enigma''.]]
When the Commander and Idair arrived at the mainframe, they found both protocols controlling an army of holodroids and creatures against one another for control of the ship. Spotting a slot on the center console, the two raced through the fighting and placed the holocron on it, causing both forces to suddenly attack them. The pair managed to hold out until the holocron unlocked and the two protocols merged to formed Darth Nul's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|personality matrix]], granting its holder the ability to command any of Nul's creations, and provided information on Nul's machine.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Darth_Nul_personality_matrix.jpg|thumb|220px|left|[[Darth Nul|Darth Nul's]] personality matrix reveals information on Nul's machine.]]
Nul had created her machine with the singular purpose of awakening the Force in billions across the galaxy, whether they had forgotten or were complete unaware of their connection, wanting them to discover their own strength without the "false dogmas" that would've suppressed their potential. While the holocron enabled the machine's operation, the completion of its gatekeeper would allow the user to direct a message to all those affected by it. To reach as many inhabitants of the galaxy as possible, Nul chose [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] for its strategic position to build her machine. The holographic Nul then became aware from the holocron's datalogs that it had been disconnected from the original machine. Upon being told by the Commander that Malgus was responsible for the destruction of both the machine and Nul's temple, Nul stated that the other suitable planet to use the machine on was [[Khar Shian]].<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Jadus_and_Rivix.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Jadus betrays the Alliance Commander.]]
Suddenly, Jadus appeared with [[Darth Rivix]] and his acolytes at his back, pleased bringing the Commander to the ''Enigma'' wasn't a waste after all, mentioning that the Hidden Chain had built Nul's machine on that planet. Now that the holocron was unlocked, he declared that the Commander had exhausted their usefulness. As the Commander prepared to fight, Jadus mocked his opponent that for all their power and skill, they failed to recognize the real threat. Suddenly, the Commander were immobilized by a forcefield, triggered by none other than Idair. As Idair took the holocron, she confessed that Jadus had [[Sa'har Kateen]], and that she was trying to barter for the return of her friend. But after she passed the holocron to Jadus, he stated that he promised the two Jedi would be "reunited". Realizing her mistake, Idair attempted to draw her lightsaber, but Jadus struck first with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], shocking her unconscious. While his acolytes carried her away, Jadus walked up to the Commander and mockingly asked the legendary hero how they found defeat after so many impossible victories. Even as the Commander defiantly promised they hadn't lost yet, Jadus disagreed.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Jadus_escapes.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Jadus escapes.]]
As the Sith Lord and his entourage took their leave, the Commander managed to disable the forcefield and attempted to attack Jadus, only for their opponent to use Sith sorcery to cause them to hallucinate. In spite of these illusions, the Commander pursued Jadus to the ventral docking bay, all while the Sith Lord [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] mocked the Commander's choices leading to this outcome and welcomed the Eternal Alliance to witness his victory on Khar Shian. As the Commander reached Jadus' shuttle, his remaining troopers attacked them to buy time for their master to escape. The Commander quickly killed all the troopers before damaging the shuttle's starboard engine, forcing Jadus to disengage the bay's forcefield, causing anything and anyone not secured to the floor, including the Commander, to be flushed out. The Commander managed to cling to the exterior of the ''Enigma'' while Jadus' shuttle managed to make it into space and rejoined his fleet, composed of two [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]]. Fortunately, the Commander was rescued by Peralun, who had disobeyed orders and followed them.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

==Aftermath==
Once aboard Peralun's shuttle, the Commander informed him of his Master's betrayal. As he began processing this information, he admitted that he was aware that Idair was struggling with the death of her friends on Elom, but he never imagined how far she'd go to rescue Sa'har. He reasoned that with the tension between the Commander and the Republic, she might've decided it was time for drastic measures.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Jadus_contacts_Heta.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Jadus contacts Heta Kol.]]
The conversation was then interrupted by a holo-transmission from Beniko, who was relieved to see the Commander alive. She then informed that both Chancellor Rans and Admiral Rava had discovered their absence and were unhappy about it. The Commander stated they didn't have time to deal with the Republic and ordered Beniko to mobilize both the Alliance and [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] forces to Khar Shian. After ending the transmission, Peralun with the Commander to consider convincing the Chancellor to grant Idair leniency. As they prepared to jump to hyperspace, the Commander winced as they experienced a hallucination of Jadus.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

[[File:Malgus_Finished_Interrogation.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Darth Malgus]] discovers the [[Hidden Chain]] presence on [[Khar Shian]].]]
Meanwhile, Heta Kol was disappointed to hear from [[Durn Wynnward]] that despite being told that they didn't need Sa'har for the new machine to work, it wasn't operational. Subsequently, [[Ri'kan Kateen|Ri'kan]] arrived with his captive sister. However, instead of welcoming her ''hibiir'' back, Heta instead brutalized him for allowing his sister to influence him and cause the near-thwarting of her plans, while Sa'har was electrocuted for protesting. She made it clear she cared nothing for his loyalty and expected success from her subordinates. However, she chose to spare him, saying that when they arrive on Khar Shian and Nul's holocron was back in her possession, he would have one last chance to prove himself. Soon after, she received a holo-transmission from Jadus, asking if she was willing to accept his offer.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

Elsewhere, Malgus, along with Shae Vizla and mercenary team attack a Hidden Chain squad. After interrogating and killing every soldier, the last one told them to go to Khar Shian, before Malgus violently threw him aside. With their destination set, Malgus proclaimed the end was upon them.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

==Behind the scenes==
If the player is affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Alliance Commander]] will go with [[Darth Rivix]] instead of [[Tau Idair]]. He will mention that Malgus' escape has caused violent unrest perpetrated by dissidents of all kinds. Additionally, the Imperial delegation is composed of Empress Acina or Emperor Vowrawn, depending on whom the player sided with in the [[War on Iokath]], along with [[Darth Krovos]], [[Darth Xarion]] and Major [[Anri]]. If the player is a Sith Warrior, Emperor Vowrawn would have special dialogue with them.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

Different dialogue is issued based on previous choices, starting with whether the player told their respective faction leader that Shae Vizla was absent or lied about it. There would also be comments on whether the player chose to give access to or withhold Nul's holocron, as well as if the player chose to tell them about Malgus' plan to destroy both the Jedi and the Sith.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

When the Chancellor or Emperor/Empress request the holocron be handed over, the player has the choice to accept or refuse. The former choice has Lana Beniko lower the forcefield around the relic, while refusing results in Krovos or Sal-Deron forcibly seizing it and attempting to unlock the holocron.

The player has the choice to either tell their faction leader about Jadus on the deck of the Alliance base or after they had been accused of tampering with the holocron. This subsequently affects dialogue with Arn Peralun or Anri.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

Prior to boarding the shuttle, when faced with either a Republic or Imperial officer while disguised as a trooper, the player can salute, stare or wave. If the third option is chosen, the Republic officer will express confusion, while the Imperial officer will comment on the lack of military discipline, which Rivix would excuse that the player is a new transfer from [[Quesh]] having accidentally inhaled the toxic air.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

When faced with Darth Jadus, the player can either agree to an alliance or refuse. For the latter choice, Jadus will lament how predictable their response is, before knocking out their companion with Force lightning. The player will then briefly fight against his acolytes, before Jadus renders them unconscious and they wake up on the lower levels of the ship. For the former choice, Jadus has his acolytes escort the player and their companion to the lower levels without a fight.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

The player can choose to visit either the Predacious or Pastoral Biome first. Tau Idair or Darth Rivix will have different dialogue depending on which biome is visited first.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

At the climax of the story, the player can be faced with different illusionary foes. The first one is either Tau Idair or Darth Rivix. The second is Sa'har Kateen, whose dialogue will differ based on whether the player chose to save Ri'kan or not. The third will be either Theron Shan, or Lana Beniko, if he was killed in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion. In addition, hallucinations of either Chancellor Rans or Emperor Vowrawn or Empress Acina would attempt to demoralize the player.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />

For Imperial players, after Jadus escapes, they would be rescued by Anri. After telling her about Rivix's betrayal, she will express her frustration with Sith like him trying to undermine the Empire. The player can either remind her of other Sith seeking to preserve the Empire, that Rivix acted like any other Sith or propose replacing the current leadership.<ref name="The Master's Enigma" />
